# zod Documentation Structure

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `contents/api.mdx` | Complete API reference for all Zod schema types, methods, and validation features |
| `contents/basics.mdx` | Basic usage guide covering schema definition, parsing data, error handling, and type inference |
| `contents/codecs.mdx` | Bidirectional transformations with `z.codec()`, `.encode()` and `.decode()` |
| `contents/compile.mdx` | Ahead-of-time schema compilation with `z.compile()` for hot validation paths |
| `contents/ecosystem.mdx` | Overview of the Zod ecosystem including integrations, tools, and community resources |
| `contents/error-customization.mdx` | Guide to customizing validation error messages and error handling patterns |
| `contents/error-formatting.mdx` | Utilities for formatting and displaying Zod errors |
| `contents/index.mdx` | Introduction to Zod, the TypeScript-first schema validation library with static type inference |
| `contents/json-schema.mdx` | Converting Zod schemas to JSON Schema and back |
| `contents/library-authors.mdx` | Guidelines and best practices for library authors integrating with Zod |
| `contents/metadata.mdx` | Attaching and manipulating metadata on Zod schemas with registries |
| `contents/packages/core.mdx` | Zod Core package, the minimal core for custom implementations |
| `contents/packages/mini.mdx` | Zod Mini, a tree-shakable variant of Zod |
| `contents/packages/zod.mdx` | Internals and structure of the Zod library |
| `contents/v4/changelog.mdx` | Changelog and migration guide for upgrading from Zod 3 to Zod 4 |
| `contents/v4/index.mdx` | Zod 4 release notes and new features, including performance improvements and breaking changes |
| `contents/v4/versioning.mdx` | Versioning strategy and compatibility information for Zod 4 |
